usedFor: Designers and marketers use Adobe Stock with “Search image” to pull stock image options for a brief, narrowing them with “Get caterogy”.

bestTemplate.name: “Search image” in Adobe Stock
bestTemplate.why: It returns images that match a search, so a step can collect options for a post or a page without opening the site.

watchOut: It searches and lists images; licensing an image still happens in Adobe Stock itself.
